_comment: RViT+ v11_part2_BROADCAST. SAME split dual-stream structure as v11_part2 (priority stream -> actor, value stream -> critic, two per-token LSTMs, split 1D-conv readout) but the CROSS-ATTENTION blocks are replaced by the Herman/Morgan FiLM-feedback + BROADCAST self-attention: Q/K/V = (content*W) (x) Prod_g (1 + gate_g*W_g) [identity-init gates -> feedback OFF at init -> reduces to plain self-attention; no explosion], LayerNorm(Q,K) BEFORE the softmax broadcast. PRIORITY: self-attn over X, FiLM gates [H1,H2], res X. VALUE: self-attn over H2, FiLM gate [X], res H2. H1=LSTM1(X), H2=LSTM2(Z_priority). Tests whether the broadcast/FiLM mechanism beats cross-attention on the v11_part2 task (compare to v11_part2 hit~0.80). 1,164,520 params. Priority: CLI > config > script default.

run._note_init_mode: fresh = random init. Broadcast is a new mechanism -> train FRESH (compare to cross-attn v11_part2).
run._note_checkpoint_location: checkpoint_dir points OUTSIDE the repo (~/rvit_plus_checkpoints/v11_part2_broadcast) on purpose: the AttentionManuscript repo is a Google Drive sync root and Drive was observed rewriting checkpoints mid-session, which can corrupt a run. Keep live checkpoints in a non-synced home dir.

environment._comment: ChangeDetectionEnv parameters — matched to the v3/HRA defaults for apples-to-apples comparison.

model._comment: Conv-free patch + cross-attention-over-memory block (8 heads) + 2 stacked per-token LSTMs + 1D-conv actor/critic heads.
model._note_patch: patch_size must divide the 50x50 image: {1,2,5,10,25,50}. patch_size=5 → 10x10 grid = 100 tokens (each 25x25 Gabor quadrant = a 5x5 patch block).
model._note_patch_hidden: The raw flattened patch is small (patch_dim = C*p*p = 3*5*5 = 75). A per-patch MLP (Linear→GELU→Linear→LayerNorm) of hidden width patch_hidden expands it up to d_model. Default 128 = d_model.
model._note_d_model: d_model = transformer/token width; d_mem = LSTM hidden = recurrent-state width the heads read. MUST be equal (128): memory (H1,H2) is concatenated into the d_model token stream as cross-attention keys/values. LSTM1 ingests the d_model attention output Z; later LSTMs ingest the previous d_mem hidden.
model._note_tx: Two PARALLEL cross-attention streams, SINGLE head each (tx_heads=1; tx_layers accepted for parity but fixed at one block per stream). BOTH query with the patch tokens X. Tμ SALIENCE: K=V=[H1 ‖ H2] (source-tagged + shared positional embedding) = 2*n_tokens keys, residual=X → feeds the ACTOR. TQ TOP-DOWN: K=V=H2 (+pos) = n_tokens keys, residual=H2 → feeds the CRITIC. Attention weights: salience (B,1,N,2N), top-down (B,1,N,N).
model._note_n_lstm: Must be 2: H1 (LSTM1, ingests the raw image X) = bottom-up sensory memory; H2 (LSTM2, ingests the salience output Z_sal) = deep memory. In v11_part2_broadcast the salience K/V reads BOTH H1 and H2; the top-down K/V + residual read H2. Each (B,n_tokens,d_mem) carried across frames. The heads do NOT read H1/H2 directly — they read the transformer outputs, SPLIT: actor←Z_sal, critic←Z_td.
model._note_head: Actor & critic decoders are 1D-CONV with a SPLIT readout: the ACTOR reads ONLY the Tμ salience output Z_sal; the CRITIC reads ONLY the TQ top-down output Z_td. Each ingests a SINGLE stream (d_model channels), arranged (B, d_model, n_tokens) and run through n_conv_layers stride-2 Conv1d layers (kernel conv_kernel, conv_channels each) over the TOKEN axis, then flatten + Linear. This PRESERVES the spatial token layout. No CLS, no action-as-input encoding. Final Linear small-init'd; actor init_action_bias on its bias. With n_tokens=100/3 stride-2 layers the token axis is 100→50→25→13.
model._note_rl_heads: Actor logits (B,n_actions) + distributional critic Q (B,n_actions,n_quantiles), each from H2 via a SEPARATE Conv1d-over-tokens trunk → flatten → Linear. init_action_bias = [wait_bias, press_bias]; [0.0,-1.5] gives initial P(press)≈0.18.

ppo._comment: PAC actor loss (MPO E-step + BC) + distributional QR-DQN critic + prioritized episode replay. RL ONLY — no recon, no PC, no pretrain.
ppo._note_pac_actor: PAC (Springenberg, Abdolmaleki et al., DeepMind 2024) REPLACES PPO's clipped surrogate. Discrete MPO E-step is closed-form: q(a|s) = softmax_a[ log π_old(a|s) + Q̄(s,a)/η ]; M-step + BC blend gives L_actor = (1−α)·[−Σ_a q(a|s)·log π_θ(a|s)] + α·[−log π_θ(a_t|s)]. η = mpo_temperature, α = bc_alpha.
ppo._note_target_network: PAC target network θ' (Springenberg et al. 2024, §3.2): the critic's distributional TD target AND the MPO E-step reference policy π_θ' BOTH come from a periodically hard-copied, time-lagged copy of θ. target_update_period = hard-copy θ→θ' every N optimizer steps; 0 disables (online bootstrap). The main stabilizer for the bootstrapped actor-critic; was missing in the original implementation.
ppo._note_burn_in: Burn-in / wait-pretrain (v3's recon_pretrain_iters, restored 2026-06-06). For the first burn_in_iters iterations the agent is FORCED to wait (action=0) so episodes run full-length, and only the critic is trained with the actor FROZEN at init — warming up the value function and recurrent representation on clean full trajectories before the policy acts. v5 has no decoder/recon (and no contrastive), so the critic/representation warm up alone. 0 disables.
ppo._note_per: Prioritized episode replay (Schaul et al. 2016, episode-level). Fresh on-policy episodes are augmented with per_n_replay replay episodes sampled ∝ priority^per_alpha (priority = mean per-step quantile-Huber error, clipped at per_priority_clip×median). IS weights (1/(N·p))^β with β annealed per_beta_start→per_beta_end over the run. per_n_replay=0 disables replay.
